name: Dining Chair Set
instruction: Let's create a 3D model of a dining chair set. Imagine a set of four chairs, each with a high backrest and a flat seat. Compare the design of these chairs to those of a standard office chair, focusing on their height, backrest angle, and seat width. Ensure the chairs are identical in design and can be neatly arranged around a dining table.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a set of four dining chairs.
Each chair has a high backrest.
Each chair has a flat seat.
The design of the chairs is identical.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The backrest height is proportionate to the seat height.
The width of the seat is proportionate to the overall chair design.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The chairs are designed to be arranged neatly around a dining table.
Each chair has sufficient space for movement around the table.
The backrests are positioned to provide support without hindering access to the table.
Object distance and contact: The chairs do not overlap when arranged around the table.
There is adequate space between each chair for comfort.
The flat seats ensure even contact with the table surface.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the dining chairs are accurately represented.
The comparison to standard office chairs is clearly outlined.
The arrangement of chairs around a dining table is correctly depicted.
